entities.summary: The Anshun Bridge is a bridge in Chengdu, Sichuan, China. It crosses the Jin River. The covered bridge contains a relatively large restaurant and is a popular eating location in the city. Anshun Bridge is a bridge from Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
